expected.insightNarrative:
HLS Patient record is a patient record dashboard for a hospital group, built on the data of Tableau's Patient Record accelerator, covering August 2022 to July 2024. Six KPIs sit at the top, and clicking one shows it in the other views; the dashboard is set to Readmissions %, shown over time, by facility, by speciality and by doctor. The story is a readmission rate of 7.3% that spiked in the autumn of 2023 and is concentrated in one facility, two specialities and a few doctors.

Key insights
- Readmissions peaked in November 2023 at 12.3% and October 2023 at 11.2%, well above the average of about 7%, after a low of 3.8% in May 2023.
- Hospital 3 is the outlier among facilities with a 100% readmission rate; Hospital 4 follows at 28.6% and Hospital 5 at 11.2%, with Hospitals 2 and 1 under 10%.
- By speciality, Neonatalogy Sick Born (11.9%) and Ophtalmology (11.0%) have the highest readmission rates and Neonatalogy Healthy Born the lowest (1.5%), with Gastroenterology (4.3%) and Obstetric (4.8%) also low; Medecine is third highest at 9.0%.
- Doctor 00019 and Doctor 00054 have 100% readmission rates and Doctor 00052 50%, while Doctors 00039 and 00003 (11.1%) and 01678 (11.2%) are the lowest of the top 15.
- The other KPIs: average length of stay 3.89 days, 21,461 stays, 933 DRG high outliers, 8,491 emergency admissions and a cost-weight per stay of 0.5733.

KPIs
Avg. LOS (days) 3.89; Nb of Stays 21,461; Readmissions % 7.3%; DRG - Nb of High Outliers 933; Emergency Admissions 8,491; Cost-Weight per Stay 0.5733.

Trend Line
Readmissions % by month from May 2023 to July 2024 against an average of about 7%: from a low of 3.8% in May 2023 it climbs to the highs of 11.2% in October and 12.3% in November 2023, falls back to about 4.8% in January 2024, and then moves between about 5% and 7.5% through July 2024, ending near 5.7%.

Facility lolipop
Readmissions % by facility, click to filter: Hospital 3 at 100%, Hospital 4 at 28.6%, Hospital 5 at 11.2%, and Hospitals 2 and 1 under 10%.

Speciality lolipop
Readmissions % by speciality: Neonatalogy Sick Born highest at 11.9%, then Ophtalmology at 11.0% and Medecine at 9.0%; Urology and Pediatrics about 8 to 9%, General surgery, Gynecology, ENT, Orthopedics and Obstetric (4.8%) about 5 to 7%, Gastroenterology 4.3%, and Neonatalogy Healthy Born lowest at 1.5%.
